channel.title: Office Hours
channel.description: The Saturday-morning on-ramp for one instructor: what tomorrow's class teaches, the real-world cases that are not on the slides, and only the week's news that a product manager can use in the room — every term in plain words.

item.description:
Companion to the Episode 2 re-cut: the cases cut for time. Sources behind this episode.

  • Commonwealth Bank backtracks on AI job cuts, apologises for 'error' — ABC News (Australia)
  • Taco Bell rethinks AI drive-through after man orders 18,000 waters — BBC
  • Delta responds to misinformation around AI pricing — Delta News Hub
  • Shopify CEO: prove AI can't do jobs before asking for more headcount — CNBC
  • MIT report: 95% of generative AI pilots at companies are failing — Fortune
  • Deloitte Australia to partially refund $290,000 report filled with AI errors — AP
  • Cursor AI support bot invents fake policy and triggers user uproar — Ars Technica
  • OpenAI's Whisper transcription tool hallucinates in hospitals, experts say — AP via Fortune
  • Judge fines Morgan & Morgan lawyers in Walmart lawsuit over fake AI-generated cases — Reuters
  • McDonald's McHire AI hiring bot exposed millions of applicants' data — WIRED
  • Hertz customers outraged over charges for scuffs detected by AI — New York Post (widely reported)
  • 'Human error': Wimbledon sorry over missed electronic line calls — BBC Sport
  • OpenAI: expanding on what we missed with sycophancy — OpenAI
  • OpenAI brings back GPT-4o after user revolt — Ars Technica
  • Humane's AI Pin is dead, as HP buys startup's assets for $116M — TechCrunch
  • Kaiser Permanente rolls out Abridge ambient AI scribe across 40 hospitals — Fierce Healthcare
